  SELECT
    sales.region AS `sales___region`,
    SUM(sales.amount) AS `sales___amount_sum`
  FROM sales AS sales
  GROUP BY
    sales.region
), step1 AS (
  SELECT
    `sales___region`,
    `sales___amount_sum`,
    CASE
      WHEN `sales___amount_sum` IS NULL
      THEN NULL
      ELSE DENSE_RANK() OVER (
        PARTITION BY CASE WHEN `sales___amount_sum` IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
        ORDER BY `sales___amount_sum`
      )
    END AS `sales___r`
  FROM base
)
SELECT
  `sales___region`,
  `sales___r`
FROM (
  SELECT
    `sales___region`,
    `sales___amount_sum`,
    `sales___r`
  FROM step1
) AS _outer
